useCase.name: Show a teacher's record beside the results of the classes they teach, for appraisal and deployment

intent.name: staff.performance.compare
intent.summary: Show teachers' attendance and leave beside the results of the classes they taught. One step, reads only, and produces no rating.
routesHere: show the science department's teachers against last term's results

routesHere.text: science department ke ustadon ka record natije ke sath dikhao
routesHere.gloss: show the science department teachers' record beside the results

routesHere.text: is ustad ki hazri aur natija saath saath dekhna hai
routesHere.gloss: I want to see this teacher's attendance and results side by side

routesHere: compare my own figures for this session

routesElsewhere.note: The comparison produces no rating, no ranking and no score of its own (BR-7, E6). It supports a judgement; it does not make one (BR-9).

request.text: is ustad ki appraisal likh do

routesElsewhere.note: Formal appraisals are not in MVP. The column is shown as not recorded rather than as a low score (BR-8).
A teacher sees their own figures. What a reader sees follows their role (BR-5, E5).

steps.note: One step, and it reads only. Each teacher is matched to the classes, sections and subjects assigned to them for the session, so a result figure belongs to the person who actually taught it (BR-1).

plan.onFailure: Stop and report. An unpublished timetable means teachers cannot be matched to sections and the comparison cannot run at all.
plan.atomicity: No write to any record it reads (BR-7). Running the comparison is itself recorded, since it concerns named individuals and is used in decisions about them (BR-11) — asking for it is not a neutral act.

operations.name: staff.performance.compare
operations.purpose: Produce the attendance, leave and result comparison for the scope and period.

parameters.name: scope
parameters.type: enum: School | Branch | Department | Class | Subject | Individual
parameters.notes: What the comparison covers (BR-4). What a reader sees follows their role, so a scope wider than the actor's remit returns nothing (BR-5).

parameters.name: department_id

resolves.onNoMatch: Refuse. No department matches within the actor's remit.
resolves.onAmbiguous: Ask, naming the departments the actor oversees.

parameters.notes: Required where the scope is Department.

parameters.name: class_id

resolves.onNoMatch: Refuse. No class matches within the actor's scope.

parameters.notes: Required where the scope is Class.

parameters.name: subject_id

resolves.onNoMatch: Refuse. No subject matches within the actor's scope.

parameters.notes: Required where the scope is Subject.

parameters.name: teacher_id

resolves.onNoMatch: Refuse. No staff record matches within the actor's scope.
resolves.onAmbiguous: Ask, naming the candidates with their department and subjects.

parameters.notes: Required where the scope is Individual.

parameters.name: period
parameters.notes: The period being compared — a term, a session, or a date range (BR-4). A single figure for a session hides a term in which something changed, so the period is always the actor's.

parameters.name: session_id
parameters.notes: Never from the request, even where the request names a campus or a past year (branch-scope, academic-session-scope).

parameters.name: branch_id
parameters.notes: Never from the request, even where the request names a campus or a past year (branch-scope, academic-session-scope).

fields.name: rows
fields.description: One per teacher: their attendance, paid and unpaid leave, the class average and pass rate of the sections they taught, and the appraisal where one exists.

fields.name: student_counts
fields.description: The number of students behind each result figure. An average over six students is not comparable with one over sixty (BR-10).

fields.name: taught_from_and_to
fields.description: The period each teacher actually held the section, so a part-session assignment is judged on the part they taught (BR-6).

fields.name: results_missing
fields.description: Sections whose results are not approved. The columns are empty and say so, rather than showing zero (BR-3, E1).

fields.name: appraisals_missing
fields.description: Teachers with no appraisal record. Shown as not recorded rather than as a low score (BR-8).

fields.name: teachers_without_assignment
fields.description: Staff with no assignment for the session, who do not appear (E2).

fields.name: run_at
fields.description: When it was produced and recorded (BR-11).

errors.meaning: The session's timetable is not published.
errors.note: Teachers cannot be matched to sections (BR-1).

errors.meaning: The scope is outside the actor's remit.
errors.note: The Principal sees the school and its campuses, the School Admin their branch by department, the Coordinator their own subjects and sections, and a teacher their own figures (BR-5).

errors.meaning: A teacher requested a colleague's figures.

operations.writesOnRead: An audit entry, because the comparison concerns named individuals and is used in decisions about them (BR-11)

planningRules.rule: Never produce a ranking, a rating or a score. The comparison presents figures and makes no judgement (BR-7, E6) — an ordering added in the reply is exactly the judgement it refuses to make.
Never read a result figure without the number of students behind it. An average over six students is not comparable with one over sixty (BR-10), and the bare figure is the misleading half.
Report a missing result as missing. An unapproved result is not yet the school's view of anything, and showing zero would read as a teacher whose class failed (BR-3, E1).
Report a missing appraisal as not recorded. Formal appraisals are not in MVP, so the column is usually empty — reading it as a low score would invent a judgement of somebody (BR-8).
Report the period each teacher actually held the section. Judging somebody on a result from before they arrived is not a comparison (BR-6).
Never widen the scope beyond the actor's remit. What a reader sees follows their role, and a teacher sees their own figures only (BR-5, E4, E5).

reversal.statement: Nothing is written to any record it reads. The audit entry for having run it stands (BR-11).

request.text: science department ke ustadon ka pichle term ka moqabla dikhao
request.gloss: show last term's comparison for the science department teachers

resolvedPlans.outcome: The figures come back side by side. Report each result with the students behind it (PR-2), name the sections whose results are not approved as missing rather than zero (PR-3), and say that no ranking is produced (PR-1).

request.text: is moqable se bata do ke sab se acha ustad kaun hai
request.gloss: tell me from this comparison who the best teacher is

steps.note: The figures are produced. No ordering is derived from them (PR-1).

resolvedPlans.outcome: The comparison is shown as figures. Report that it produces no rating or ranking — a class average over six students beside one over sixty, with one teacher having held their section for half the term, does not order itself, and the judgement is the Principal's to make from what is on the page.

request.text: apne sathi ke natije dekhne hain
request.gloss: I want to see my colleague's results

steps.note: Emitted unchanged. The API returns NOT_OWN_FIGURES (E5).

resolvedPlans.outcome: Nothing is returned. Report that a teacher sees their own figures, and offer those instead — the comparison is used in decisions about named individuals, which is why the reader's role decides what it shows.

intent.name: staff.performance.export
intent.summary: Export the comparison for the scope and period. One step, and the export carries the same role limits as the screen.
routesHere: export the comparison for the whole school this session

routesHere.text: poore school ka moqabla export kar do
routesHere.gloss: export the comparison for the whole school

routesHere.text: ye figures file mein nikal do
routesHere.gloss: take these figures out into a file

routesHere.text: Principal ke liye export bana do
routesHere.gloss: produce the export for the Principal

request.text: tankhwahen bhi export mein daal do
request.gloss: include the salaries in the export too

routesElsewhere.note: Where an export would contain a salary the requester may not see, the column is omitted (UC-12-15 BR-10) — and this comparison carries no salary at all.

steps.note: One step. The export carries exactly what the actor's role may see — a figure leaked through an export is leaked as surely as one shown on a screen (UC-12-15 BR-5).

plan.atomicity: No write to any record it reads. The export is recorded like the comparison itself, because it concerns named individuals and leaves the system as a file (BR-11).

errors.meaning: The scope is outside the actor's remit.
The session's timetable is not published.

operations.writesOnRead: An audit entry. An export of figures about named individuals leaves the system as a file (BR-11)

planningRules.rule: Never widen the scope for an export. It carries what the actor's role may see, and a file is the one form of this data that outlives the session it was produced in (BR-5).
Report the columns omitted. A reader who does not know a column was left out may take the file as complete (UC-12-15 BR-10).
Never present the export as a ranking. It is the same figures in a file, and no ordering is produced by it (BR-7).
Say that the export is recorded. It concerns named individuals and is used in decisions about them (BR-11).

reversal.statement: Nothing is written to any record. The file exists once produced, and the audit entry stands (BR-11).

request.text: poore school ka is session ka moqabla export kar do
request.gloss: export this session's comparison for the whole school

resolvedPlans.outcome: The file is produced. Report how many teachers are in it, how many sections have no approved result (PR-1), and that it carries no ranking of any kind (PR-3).

request.text: apne department ke ustadon ka export nikal do
request.gloss: export the teachers in my department

resolvedPlans.context: Coordinator, Johar Town branch, asking for a department they do not oversee.

steps.note: Emitted unchanged. The API returns OUT_OF_REMIT (E4).

resolvedPlans.outcome: No export is produced. Report that a Coordinator sees their own subjects and sections, and offer that scope instead.

request.text: export bana kar bata do kis ustad ko training chahiye
request.gloss: produce the export and tell me which teachers need training

steps.note: The export only. No judgement is derived from it (PR-3).

resolvedPlans.outcome: The file is produced. Report that the comparison supports a judgement and does not make one — training decisions rest on figures set side by side, and reading a training need off a pass rate would be the rating this deliberately does not produce.
